name: Rubeus
summary: C# toolset for raw Kerberos interaction and abuse: ticket requests, Kerberoasting, AS-REP roasting, pass-the-ticket, overpass-the-hash, delegation abuse, and S4U.
description: Rubeus (part of GhostPack) is the go-to tool for Active Directory Kerberos attacks. It can request and renew TGTs/TGSs, harvest and inject tickets, perform Kerberoasting and AS-REP roasting for offline cracking, and abuse constrained / unconstrained / resource-based constrained delegation.
